Assassin handles the weapon, nearly two meters in length, with perfect freedom. Saber has yet to take a single step within his reach.

One meter separates Saber’s reach from Assassin’s.

Only a few steps of stone lie between them, yet Saber cannot advance even that far.

She bites her lip.

There is no time to continue this skirmish.

She surpasses him in raw strength. If she uses her magical energy and the force of her sword as a shield, he is not an opponent she cannot overwhelm.

One blow.

If she resolves herself to suffer a single blow, she can subdue him with ease.

多少の傷に怯まなければ二撃目はない。
甘んじて一撃を受けた瞬間、彼女はアサシンに踏み込み、敵を両断する自信がある。

If she refuses to flinch from a lesser wound, he will never have the opportunity to strike twice.

The instant she accepts the blow, she is confident she can enter Assassin’s guard and cleave him in two.

If that single blow is certain to take her head, she cannot force her way through.

Every stroke of the Servant before her is such a blow.

He never feints. Every attack seeks her life.

Retreat is the only means of defending against it.

The narrow terrain prevents her from circling him, and his consummate skill will not allow her to advance.

“…Ah. A blade worthy of Saber. I thought mine might endure several exchanges, yet a single blow has bent it…!”

Sparks spill between them.

Sword and blade lock at their guards, each struggling to force the other aside.

「受けた……？ アサシンが、私の剣を……？」
アサシンの刀は脆い。
鉄さえ両断するという業物ではあるが、所詮は人の手による物。人ならざる業によって鍛えられた彼女の剣とは比べるべくもない。
正面から力のみで打ち合えば、確実に長刀は粉砕される。
それを知っているからこそアサシンは剣を受け流し、剣ではなく体を狙う事でセイバーを退かせていたのだ。

“He blocked it…? Assassin blocked my sword…?”

Assassin’s blade is fragile.

It may be a masterpiece said to cut even iron, but it remains a weapon forged by human hands. It cannot compare with her sword, wrought through an art beyond mankind.

If the two weapons met head-on in a contest of strength, the long blade would unquestionably shatter.

Assassin knew this. That was why he had always turned her sword aside and forced her back by striking at her body rather than her weapon.

pages.ja:
だが、アサシンは自ら受けた。
いかに鍛え上げられ、アサシン自身の“粘り”があったところで、刀ではセイバーの一撃を防げない。
セイバーの一撃を受け止めた長刀は芯が曲がっている。
その様では、もはや今までの鋭利さは保てまい。

However thoroughly the blade has been tempered, whatever resilience Assassin’s own skill may lend it, no mere sword can withstand Saber’s blow.

The long blade that caught her strike is bent at its core.

It can no longer retain the deadly edge it possessed until now.

アサシンがセイバーの剣を受け止めた事には意味がある。
それが何の為なのか気付く前に、彼女はその位置に立たされていた。

*…Can I win? Can I defeat this man without injury…?*

She asks herself as she bears down upon Assassin’s long sword.

That hesitation becomes carelessness.

There was a purpose in Assassin’s decision to receive her blade.

Before she understands what it was, he has maneuvered her into position.

体の位置が、変わっている。
階段の上と下とに別れた二人の立ち位置が、今は平行。
セイバーは気が付かないうちに体を横にずらされ、真っ平らな足場に立たされている。

“…!”

Her position has changed.

They had been separated by the upper and lower steps. Now they stand level with one another.

Without even realizing it, Saber has been drawn sideways onto perfectly flat ground.

お互いが水平になる立ち位置。
秘剣を振るうに適した足場。

燕返し。

They stand upon the same plane.

The footing is ideal for unleashing his secret technique.

Here, Assassin can display his sorcerous sword.

—Tsubame Gaeshi.

Three circling blades surround their target at the same instant, denying both defense and escape, and unfailingly taking the enemy’s life.

“Assassin, you…!”

The strength in Saber’s sword slackens.

She could still bear him down.

With her superior strength, she could hurl Assassin aside and rush forward to finish him—or simply race past him to the gate.

Whether she advances to finish him after throwing him back or turns away and runs for the gate, the moment he unleashes that sorcerous blade, everything will be over.

She cannot press forward.

Her only recourse is to ease her strength, match Assassin’s pressure, and remain locked against him.

Assassin regards the cornered Saber with satisfaction.

There is no cruelty in his gaze.

The swordsman is simply captivated by the eyes of an opponent driven to the brink, still searching for one stroke that will overturn her fate.

Assassin has seen through her heart, but his words are not a taunt—

She pours magical energy into the blade, meaning to cast aside the obstacle before her.

…But she cannot.

That instant would be her end.

If she opens the distance now, she will have fallen precisely into Assassin’s design.

“From the beginning, we were summoned for no purpose but to fulfill our respective roles.

“As I protect this gate, so too do you have something you must protect.

“Then there can be no room for hesitation.

“And besides, Saber, you are not the only one who has little time remaining.”

They are the first and last true words of a swordsman who has lived only to fulfill an imaginary role.

He wants to see what will come when they have both expended everything they possess.

The swordsman before her has spoken his sole desire—the one reward he asks for being summoned into this age and guarding this gate until the end.

pages.en:
—She advances through a sea of rotting flesh.

The pond is less than a meter deep.

Its floor is thickly carpeted with the mass, so in truth she sinks only to her knees.

“This—this is beyond disgusting! God…!”

She curses between ragged breaths.

Each step brings the sickening sensation of crushing a swarm of insects beneath her feet.

The carrion clinging to her skin is exactly what it appears to be. If she stops moving, it begins to harden around her, trying to draw her inside.

“Kh…! Oh, damn it all…!”

She tears it away by force and presses onward.

Slosh. Slosh. Squelch.

No sane person could endure wading through its contents.

*After this, butchering a whole cow would be nothing,* Rin Tohsaka decides with grim resignation.

And so she grows accustomed even to this labor.

The situation is so desperate that she would be unable to move if she did not regard it as mere work, but at least the sight no longer wounds her spirit.

“Kh… ah, hah, ah—”

This, however, is not something she can endure by changing her state of mind.

Her body grows hotter with every step.

The carrion that wraps around her legs invades her nerves the instant it touches her. By the time she tears it off, the poison has already entered her system.

A curse.

This tangible embodiment of malice toward others is like a violent ague.

Touching it brings immediate illness.

It invades the nerves, steals strength, and boils the brain. By the first step, its effects are lethal.

An ordinary person would stop moving after the second and collapse into the rotting flesh.

What happened after that, she does not know.

She has no desire to imagine whether they would suffocate or become another part of the carrion.

Her head, already burning above forty degrees, is hardly capable of imagining anything at all.

“Ghh—damn… you—”

She fights desperately to steady her faltering feet and swaying body, forcing herself onward.

…Rin did not leap into the carrion entirely without a plan.

She swallowed two of her remaining treasured jewels and committed all the magical energy stored within them to a defensive membrane.

If this curse is crystallized magical energy, then surrounding herself with sufficiently powerful energy should repel it—

“Kh—this is… bad—”

…Her vision warps.

Her prediction was correct, but she misjudged the scale.

The jewels she swallowed might as well have been paper.

This is not something a human being can resist.

No person could pass through it without having something taken from them.

…Here, only one thing keeps her alive:

the strength she can muster against her own failing self.

“It’s—hot—God… At this rate, jumping into a sea of fire would be cooler.”

In fact, protected by her jewels, she could leap into a sea of fire without harm.

The instant the meaningless complaint leaves her mouth—

“——”

her own flippancy infuriates her, and her resolve returns.

No. That is not true at all.

This suffering cannot begin to compare, and she has no right to make so light of it.

Through her fevered haze, she listens to the clash of swords behind her.

…She can no longer see either combatant.

Perhaps Shirou Emiya drew him away. Perhaps he was simply driven back with no means of resisting.

Whichever it was, their battle seems to have moved into the temple grounds.

“—Just a little farther. I’ll make it in one rush, so until then…”

She runs.

Even so, she can manage little more than walking speed, but she keeps her legs moving.

She forces her way through the rotting flesh.

Breathing raggedly and without dignity, she reaches toward the mound.

“There—!”

She climbs almost on all fours.

The mountain of flesh is solid beneath her hands.

だが実際はこの始末だ。
ヤツの宝具を防ぎ、踏み込んで一撃食らわせる事もできない。
pages.en:
“Damn—that bastard. How am I supposed to…”

Archer told me that I alone could defeat him.

Yet this is the reality.

I can do nothing but block his Noble Phantasms. I cannot even close the distance and land a single blow.

pages.ja:
二つ。最低でも二つの武器が必要だ。
が、一本でさえこの始末だっていうのに、同時に投影する事なんて出来るものか……！
pages.jaRuby:
二つ。最低でも二つの武器が必要だ。

pages.en:
Two. I need at least two weapons.

But when producing even one has reduced me to this, how can I possibly Project two at the same time…!?

pages.ja:
「どうした。歯ごたえがあるのは口先だけかフェイカー」
転がりまわる俺の姿が気に入ったのか、ヤツはあくまで愉しげだ。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“What is the matter? Was your tongue the only part of you with any bite, Faker?”

Apparently pleased by the sight of me rolling across the ground, he remains thoroughly entertained.

pages.ja:
「は
あ」

満悦している分にはいい。
それならまだ、未熟な自分にも勝ち目はある
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Hah—ah.”

…I steady my breathing.

So long as he remains pleased with himself, that is fine.

While he does, even someone as inexperienced as I am may still have a chance—

pages.ja:
「
投影、開始」
内界に意識を向ける。
限られた僅かな回路。
そこに、限界まで設計図を並べていく。
……視認できるヤツの宝具は十七個。

pages.en:
“—Trace, on.”

I turn my awareness inward.

The few limited circuits available to me.

I line them with blueprints to the very edge of capacity.

…Seventeen of his Noble Phantasms are presently visible.

From their outward forms, I read their internal structures, draw out the principles behind their creation, and determine their constituent materials—

pages.ja:
「ごぶっ
…………！」
吐血する。
通常一つか二つしか入らない回路に、複数の魔術を走らせている代償だ。
投影を始めてから神経は傷つき、体は内側から崩壊している。
胃には血が溜まり、食道はポンプのように、血液を外に吐き出させようとする。

pages.en:
“Guh…!”

I vomit blood.

This is the price of forcing multiple spells through circuits that ordinarily hold only one or two.

My nerves have been sustaining damage since I began the Projection, and my body is collapsing from within.

Blood pools in my stomach, and my esophagus works like a pump trying to expel it.

pages.ja:
「
憑依経験、共感終了」
それを飲み込んで、工程を押し進める。
干将莫耶ではヤツの宝具は防げない。
アーチャーほどの剣技があれば双剣でも防げるだろうが、俺にそれだけの技量はない。

pages.en:
“—Possession experience assimilated. Sympathy complete.”

I swallow the blood and force the process onward.

Kanshou and Bakuya cannot stop his Noble Phantasms.

With Archer’s skill, the twin swords might suffice, but I do not possess his mastery.

pages.ja:
剣技に劣る俺が宝具を防ぐ方法はただ一つ。
放たれた宝具とまったく同じ宝具をぶつける事で、単純に相殺するしかない
！

！
pages.en:
There is only one way for my inferior swordsmanship to stop a Noble Phantasm.

I have to strike each one with an identical Noble Phantasm and cancel it through sheer collision—!

pages.ja:
「ふ
ふう、ふ
」
魔力ならまだ保つ。
遠坂からの供給は半端じゃない。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Hah—hah…”

My magical energy will hold a little longer.

The power Tohsaka is supplying me is extraordinary.

pages.ja:
……ただ、それを動かす回路自体が、根本から倒壊しかけている。
終わりは近い。
pages.jaRuby:
……ただ、それを動かす回路自体が、根本から倒壊しかけている。
終わりは近い。
pages.en:
…But the circuits carrying that power are themselves beginning to collapse at their foundations.

The end is near.

pages.ja:
ヤツが本気になった時、同じ数の剣を投影しなければ生き残れない。
だがそれだけの数を投影すれば、間違いなく、この体は破裂する。

pages.en:
When he becomes serious, I will have to Project the same number of swords he fires if I mean to survive.

But if I Project so many, this body will burst without question.

pages.ja:

工程完了。全投影、待機」
溢れ出すイメージを保存する。
……外に出ようとする剣は、そのイメージ通り中から体を串刺しにするモノだ。
回路が焼き切れ制御できなくなれば、衛宮士郎は内から突き出される刃によって、それこそ針千本と化す。

pages.en:
“—Process complete. All Projections standing by.”

I preserve the images threatening to overflow.

…The swords straining to emerge will pierce my body from within, exactly as their images suggest.

If my circuits burn out and I lose control, the blades will erupt through Shirou Emiya from the inside and turn him into a living pincushion.

pages.ja:
「ほう。今度は多いな。十、十五、十七……そうか、目に見える我の宝具を全て複製した訳か」
「な
に？」
pages.jaRuby:

に？」
pages.en:
“Oh? You have more this time. Ten, fifteen, seventeen… I see. You have reproduced every treasure of mine presently visible.”

“What—?”

pages.ja:
「舐めるな。魔術師の手の内など看破できなくて何が英霊か。おまえに働く魔術の数など、それこそ手に取るように判る」
「
」

」
pages.en:
“Do not insult me. What manner of Heroic Spirit would fail to see through a mage’s workings? The number of spells operating within you is as plain to me as though I held them in my hand.”

“——”

pages.ja:
その台詞に、不意をつかれた。
千の財宝を所有する英雄王は、視ただけでこちらの魔術を把握するというのか、と。

pages.en:
His words catch me by surprise.

Does the King of Heroes, master of a thousand treasures, comprehend my magecraft merely by looking at me?

“Kh—!”

I react too late.

The instant I allowed his words to distract me has placed me hopelessly behind—!

pages.en:
Seventeen Noble Phantasms are released.

The King’s Treasury. A fraction of its contents surges toward me, proclaiming that playtime is over…!

“—Suspension released! All Projections, sequential layered replication…!”

pages.ja:
「は

！」

pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Hah—gh!”

My body wavers.

The swords fired from within me collide with those launched from the outer world, and the impacts shake me inside and out.

pages.ja:
「あ
が

防ぎきれない。
十七個の宝具を投影したところで、自分に出来るのは一本ずつカタチにするだけ。
いかに連続といえ一本ずつしか出せない自分と、

！

！
pages.en:
“Agh—aaaaah…!”

I cannot stop them all.

Even after Projecting seventeen Noble Phantasms, I can give form to them only one at a time.

However rapidly I produce them, I am releasing one after another—while he fires every weapon simultaneously.

From the beginning, the difference in firepower has been overwhelming—!

pages.ja:
「はは、硝子細工にしてはよく持つが、それもあと数撃か。そら、急いで真似ねば八つ裂きだぞ」
剣戟の向こうで、ヤツの嘲笑う声がする。
敵宝具、残り十二
！
pages.jaRuby:

剣戟の向こうで、ヤツの嘲笑う声がする。
敵宝具、残り十二
！
pages.en:
“Hah! You have endured well for a piece of glasswork, but you have only a few blows left in you. Hurry and imitate them, or you will be torn limb from limb.”

His derisive voice reaches me through the clamor of colliding blades.

Twelve enemy Noble Phantasms remain—!

pages.ja:
「しかし、ほとほと愚考よな。
我には勝ち得ないと考え、聖杯だけでも取り外す判断は正しい。おまえでは我には敵うべくもない」
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“But truly, what consummate folly.

“You were correct to judge that you could not defeat me and resolve to remove the Holy Grail instead. You could never hope to rival me.”

pages.ja:
「つ
！」

自ら放出する魔力と、その寸前で衝突し、弾け合う宝具の熱が、指を容赦なく灼いていく。
残る宝具、あと七つ
！

！
pages.en:
“Gh—!”

The fingers thrust out before me begin to burn.

The magical energy pouring from my body and the heat of the Noble Phantasms colliding and detonating a breath away sear them without mercy.

Seven Noble Phantasms remain—!

pages.ja:
「だが、それならばあの男を殺してしまえばよかろう。

！」

pages.en:
“But in that case, you need only have killed that man.

“If you wished to stop the Grail, disposing of Shinji would be the surest method. As magi, you surely possessed some means of killing him without crossing that mud.

“—Hmph. Yet still you seek to save him. Such hypocrisy is the perfect embodiment of a mongrel—!”

pages.ja:
「あ
は、あ
」
……切れる。
回路が、完全に焼き切れる。
足りない。こんな僅かな回路だけじゃ、この男には敵わない
！
pages.jaRuby:

！
pages.en:
“Ah—hah—”

…They are breaking.

My circuits are burning out completely.

There are too few of them. I cannot defeat this man with so few circuits—!

pages.ja:
「く
そ、なん、で…………！」
なぜ防げないのか。
ヤツは勝てると言った。なのに勝負にさえなりはしない。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Damn—it. Why…!?”

Why can I not stop them?

Archer said I could win. Yet I cannot even make this a contest.

pages.ja:

that I, Shirou Emiya, have misunderstood something?

pages.en:
“Gh—aaaaah!”

Three Noble Phantasms remain.

Will my body endure until I have stopped them?

No, that is not what I should be thinking about. What matters is the difference between the swords I create and the swords *he* created—

pages.ja:
「
え？」
瞬間、あらゆる感覚が停止した。
迫り来る残り三つの宝具さえ目に入らない。
黄金のサーヴァントは、一つの剣を取りだしていた。
奇怪な剣。
石柱ともとれるソレを見た時点で、思考が白熱したと言っていい。
pages.jaRuby:

奇怪な剣。

pages.en:
“——What?”

In that instant, every one of my senses stops.

Even the three Noble Phantasms hurtling toward me vanish from my awareness.

The golden Servant has drawn a single sword.

A grotesque weapon.

The moment I see the thing that might as easily be a stone pillar, my thoughts turn white with heat.

pages.ja:
「女を救うと言ったな、小僧」
剣の咆哮に乗って、嘲笑う声が響く。
回路に残る三つの魔術を全て破棄し、全速でヤツの剣を解読する。
pages.jaRuby:
「女を救うと言ったな、小僧」
剣の咆哮に乗って、嘲笑う声が響く。
回路に残る三つの[ruby text=せっけいず char=2]魔術を全て破棄し、全速でヤツの剣を[ruby text=リード char=2]解読する。
pages.en:
“You said you would save the woman, boy.”

His mocking voice rides upon the roar of the sword.

I discard all three spells remaining in my circuits and devote my full speed to reading his weapon.

pages.ja:
だが。
“
読め、ない……？”
今まで、それが剣であるのならどんな物だって読みとれたというのに。
あの剣だけは、その構造さえ読みとれ、ない。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
But—

*—I can’t… read it?*

Until now, if something was a sword, I could read it without exception.

Yet that weapon alone—I cannot read so much as its structure.

pages.ja:
「ならば見せてみろ。その贋作で、一体何が救えるのかを！」
風が、断層を作り上げる。
ギルガメッシュの剣から放たれた斬風は、自らの宝具さえ蹴散らして衛宮士郎に襲いかかる。

pages.en:
“Then show me. What can that counterfeit of yours possibly save!?”

—Wind forms a fault line.

The cutting gale released from Gilgamesh’s sword scatters even his own Noble Phantasms and bears down upon Shirou Emiya.

pages.ja:
「
」
思考は白いまま。
対抗策など何も考えられず、ただ、残った魔力を叩きつけた
pages.jaRuby:

」

pages.en:
“——”

My thoughts remain blank.

Unable to conceive of any defense, I simply hurl all the magical energy I have left against it—
